payload.title: Cargo workspace scaffolding + Rust CI
payload.description: Add a top-level Cargo workspace under crates/ alongside the pnpm workspace. Pin toolchain (rust-toolchain.toml), set up rustfmt/clippy config, deny-warnings policy, and GitHub Actions jobs (build, test, clippy, fmt) wired into the existing CI. Decide crate naming convention (frick-protocol, frick-schema, frick-store, frick-server, frick-cli, ...) and document the layout in AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md.
